title: OneCodeReviewBench: Typed Decisions for Code Review and Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.33389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code review requires finding functional bugs, memory-safety errors, security weaknesses, and performance problems across languages and software stacks. Tools can express bounded parts of this work as decisions about supplied code. We present OneCodeReviewBench, 1,968 synthetic cases across 12 programming languages and YAML, with Boolean, categorical, and ordered answers. Explicit contracts specify runtime assumptions, source scope, and answer criteria; separate evidence records support reference review. One author reviewed 150 cases; two additional engineers reviewed 100 of those cases. We compare ten model--adapter systems on the same cases and contracts: OpenAI Decisions reaches 81.3% Boolean balanced accuracy; Kev-27B reaches 76.8% Choice accuracy and Score mean absolute error of 0.367. translated_title: OneCodeReviewBench：面向代码审查与搜索的类型化决策基准
translated_abstract: 代码审查需要在多种编程语言和软件栈中发现功能性缺陷、内存安全错误、安全弱点和性能问题。工具可以将这项工作中边界明确的部分表达为对给定代码的决策。我们提出OneCodeReviewBench，包含覆盖12种编程语言和YAML的1,968个合成案例，答案类型包括布尔型、类别型和有序型。明确的契约规定了运行时假设、源代码范围和答案评判标准；独立的证据记录支持参考审查。一位作者审查了150个案例，另外两名工程师审查了其中的100个案例。我们在相同的案例和契约上比较了十个模型-适配器系统：OpenAI Decisions达到81.3%的布尔型平衡准确率；Kev-27B达到76.8%的选择准确率和0.367的评分平均绝对误差。在排除两个契约不完整的模型家族后，这些领先系统依然保持优势。额外的比较涵盖586个使用原始符号搜索的案例以及40个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出OneCodeReviewBench基准，包含覆盖12种编程语言和YAML的1,968个具有类型化答案（布尔、类别、有序）的合成代码审查案例，并通过十个模型-适配器系统的评测揭示了当前领先模型在代码审查决策任务上的性能水平。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces OneCodeReviewBench, a benchmark of 1,968 synthetic code review cases with typed decisions (Boolean, categorical, and ordered answers) across 12 programming languages and YAML, evaluating ten model-adapter systems to reveal the performance of leading models on code review tasks.
